_comment: Pre-declared before running: an independent repeat of the eta V1/V2 for parent_sampler=envelope, whose first run passed V1/V2 with a cluster of low p-values on one point, plus a high-statistics check of the envelope on the K0 parent laws. Committed before the jobs start; the result is judged only by the rule below.

previous_result.V2: pass (KS 0.24, min p 0.0025, max tail pull 2.32); 4 of 112 p-values below 0.01 (1.1 expected), all on mb_eta_m005: theta_e 0.0087, theta_e|E_e_q0 0.0091, theta_e|E_e_q1 0.0054, theta_e|E_e_q2 0.0025; parent_p 0.42 and parent_theta 0.76 on that point
previous_result.stock_sampler_same_seeds: pass (V1 max |pull| 1.89, chi2 p 0.49; V2 KS 0.29, min p 0.0074, 1 of 112 below 0.01); mb_eta_m005 theta_e 0.36, q0 0.038, q1 0.21, q2 0.41
previous_result.parent_over_bar: 0 in every shard of both runs

rerun.trials: as validation/run_v_set.sh V_SET=eta (5e8 per mb_eta point, 2e8 per he_eta_cuboid point)
rerun.reference: the same stock reference sets as the first run

control.role: reported alongside; a failure here would point at the criteria or the reference, not at the envelope, and is reported as such

parent_check.note: the parent law does not depend on the DM mass, so one card per law

envelope_validated_for_eta_if_all: the rerun passes every V1 and V2 criterion of v_config_eta.json
each of the four histograms flagged before (mb_eta_m005 theta_e, theta_e|E_e_q0, theta_e|E_e_q1, theta_e|E_e_q2) has p > 0.01 in the rerun
no envelope bound violation (parent_over_bar = 0) in any shard of the rerun
parent check: every histogram (p, theta, pT; and v for bpmt_k0) has p > 0.001, and the envelope has over_bar = 0, on both cards
decision_rule.otherwise: not validated for eta; the envelope stays opt-in and is documented as unvalidated for eta_decay; next step is a targeted look at the parents of detected DM (theta, p) in the envelope against the stock sampler at high statistics
decision_rule.no_further_reruns: a third run to obtain a pass is not allowed under this rule; it would need a new declaration with reasons
decision_rule.reporting: both envelope runs, the control and the parent check are reported in docs/gpu-validation.md whatever the outcome
